title: Supply, Testing and Commissioning of High-Pressure Subsea Control Valves & Flow Control Skids for Offshore Deepwater Operations
organization: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) / MoPNG

clauses.heading: Legal Status and Entity Eligibility
clauses.raw_text: The bidder must be a company registered under the Companies Act, 2013 or a registered Partnership / LLP. The entity must possess a valid PAN, active GSTIN registration in the operating state, and must not be debarred or blacklisted by GeM, MoPNG, or any PSU on the date of bid submission.

requirements.title: Active GSTIN Registration
requirements.description: Bidder must possess active and un-suspended GSTIN registration matching the legal entity name.

requirements.title: Non-Debarment Declaration
requirements.description: Bidder must not be blacklisted or under debarment proceedings by GeM or central ministries.

clauses.heading: Financial Standing — Minimum Average Annual Turnover
clauses.raw_text: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three financial years (FY 2022-23, FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25) must not be less than INR 10,00,00,000 (Ten Crore Rupees). Audited balance sheets and profit & loss statements certified by a Chartered Accountant with valid UDIN must be submitted.

requirements.title: Minimum Annual Turnover Threshold
requirements.description: Audited turnover must equal or exceed INR 10 Crore across certified FY submissions.
requirements.required_evidence_type: Audited Balance Sheets with UDIN & CA Certificate

clauses.heading: Working Capital and Bank Solvency
clauses.raw_text: The bidder must submit a Bank Solvency Certificate from a Scheduled Commercial Bank for an amount not less than INR 3,00,00,000 (Three Crore Rupees), issued not earlier than six months prior to the date of tender issuance.

requirements.title: Bank Solvency Certificate
requirements.description: Solvency certificate >= INR 3 Crore from scheduled bank issued within 6 months.

clauses.heading: Technical Capability & Prior Supply Experience
clauses.raw_text: The bidder or its designated OEM must have successfully supplied at least 50 units of API 6D or API 6A rated high-pressure valves (Rating 10,000 PSI or above) to PSUs, Central Govt Departments, or offshore upstream operators in the preceding 5 financial years. Satisfactory completion certificates must be attached.

requirements.title: Past Experience API 6D / 6A Valves
requirements.description: Supply proof of at least 50 high-pressure valve units with performance certificates.

clauses.heading: Mandatory Standards & Technical Certifications
clauses.raw_text: The product offered must carry mandatory Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certification under applicable Indian standard (IS 13095 / IS/ISO 10423) or valid API Monogram. Additionally, manufacturing facility must hold ISO 9001:2015 and statutory PESO / CCOE explosion-proof certificates valid on the date of bid submission.

requirements.title: Valid BIS / API Quality Certificate
requirements.description: BIS or API certificate must be active and strictly valid on the bid submission date (15-Sep-2026).
requirements.applicable_rule: BIS Conformity Assessment Regulations & Tender Specific Cl 5.2

requirements.title: Pollution Control Board Clearance (SPCB NOC)
requirements.description: Valid Consent to Operate (CTO) from State Pollution Control Board for manufacturing premises.

clauses.heading: Preference to Make in India (MII) Compliance
clauses.raw_text: In accordance with DPIIT Order No. P-45021/2/2017-PP (BE-II), only Class-I Local Suppliers (local content >= 50%) and Class-II Local Suppliers (local content >= 20%) are eligible. For tenders with estimated value exceeding Rs 10 Crore, local content declaration must be certified by a statutory auditor or cost accountant.

requirements.title: Class-I Local Content Certification (>= 50%)
requirements.description: Audited certification of local value addition >= 50% with itemized bill of materials.
requirements.applicable_rule: Public Procurement Order (Preference to Make in India) 2017

clauses.heading: MSME / Startup Exemption & Employee Compliances
clauses.raw_text: Bidders claiming exemption from prior turnover or experience under MSME / Startup India must submit valid Udyam Registration Certificate or DPIIT Recognition. Bidders must also provide proof of statutory employee compliance (EPFO / ESIC returns).

requirements.title: MSME Udyam / Startup Recognition Verification
requirements.description: Valid Udyam registration matching entity PAN with active enterprise status.

requirements.title: Statutory Employee Compliances (EPF/ESIC)
requirements.description: Consistent employee headcount declaration between regulatory filings and EPF returns.
